brand.name: Paws&Co.
brand.tagline: An Internet-based Near Real-time Dog Tracking System
brand.description: Protect your beloved pets with high-precision GPS + NB-IoT tracking and smart QR Code identification tags.

landing.heroSubtitle: Innovative smart tracking collar combining GPS, cellular NB-IoT, and digital QR Code ID for total pet safety and peace of mind.
landing.featuresTitle: Key Features Designed for Pet Lovers
landing.featuresSubtitle: Comprehensive real-time tracking, intelligent safety geofences, and instant recovery assistance.
landing.f1Desc: High-accuracy GNSS/GPS tracking updates every 10 seconds when outside safe zones via cellular IoT.
landing.f2Desc: Designate safe perimeters around home or parks and receive instant alerts when your dog wanders away.
landing.f3Desc: Digital identifier tag on the collar for anyone who finds your dog to instantly contact you without exposing sensitive personal info.
landing.f4Desc: Review past walking routes, daily activity, travel distance, and battery health trends.
landing.step1Desc: Attach the lightweight, IP67 waterproof Paws&Co. collar to your dog.
landing.step2Desc: Configure home and park perimeters with customizable radiuses in the app.
landing.step3Desc: Enjoy peace of mind with live map updates and instant push notifications.
landing.previewSubtitle: Optimized for desktop, tablet, and mobile with responsive UI and clean design system.

dashboard.title: Live Tracking Dashboard
dashboard.subtitle: Monitor real-time positions, telemetry signals, and battery levels of all pets.
dashboard.sosConfirmDesc: This will broadcast your dog's current coordinates to the system and record an emergency alert.

pets.title: My Pets
pets.subtitle: Manage pet profiles, medical history, safe zones, and device hardware.
pets.emptyDesc: Register your first pet to start real-time tracking and generate digital QR tags.

addPet.subtitle: Enter pet details, upload photos, and pair with smart IoT collar.
addPet.healthPlaceholder: Detail any allergies, medication, or special care instructions...
addPet.photosDesc: Choose clear photos showing face and distinct markings. The first photo will be primary.
addPet.manualDevice: Or enter MAC Address / Device ID manually

petDetails.title: Pet Details
petDetails.deleteConfirmDesc: This action cannot be undone. All telemetry history, vaccination records, and safe zones will be permanently deleted.
petDetails.qrInstructions: Print or attach this QR tag to your pet's collar so anyone who finds them can scan to contact you.

history.title: Location History
history.subtitle: Review historical travel paths, activity timeline, and movement analytics.
history.noHistory: No location records found for the selected timeframe.

hardware.title: Hardware & IoT Management
hardware.subtitle: LILYGO T-SIM7080G-S3 ESP32-S3 board specifications and collar pairing.
hardware.chipset: Microcontroller: ESP32-S3 Dual-Core Xtensa LX7 (16MB Flash, 8MB PSRAM)
hardware.cellular: Modem: SIM7080G supporting NB-IoT & LTE Cat-M1 worldwide bands
hardware.power: Power: 3.7V 1,000 mAh Li-Po Battery with PMU Power Management IC
hardware.led: Indicator: WS2812B Addressable RGB LED for status & night illumination
hardware.casing: Enclosure: IP67 Waterproof protective project box tailored for pet collars
hardware.pairStep1: 1. Power on tracker and observe flashing green WS2812B LED.
hardware.pairStep2: 2. Enter MAC address or scan collar QR code.
hardware.pairStep3: 3. Click 'Pair' to bind device with your account.

settings.offlineAlert: Alert when device disconnects for > 1 hour
